content_notes.home: Official site states Quarteira Beach is 800 m away; adult and separate children pools; Vilamoura 5-minute drive; Faro Airport 20 km. Homepage has an apparent duplicate 2pax card labelled sleeps 3; do not reproduce inconsistency.
content_notes.services: Reception 24h, daily cleaning, free Wi-Fi specifically in reception and bar, satellite TV, room air conditioning, common grill, adult and child pools 09:00–20:00, pool bar same hours, private garage, cot free on request, ticket sales and transfers, massage/babysitting by advance appointment. Verify availability before launch.
content_notes.contacts: Rua da Abelheira, Edifício Solgarve, 8125-173 Quarteira, Algarve, Portugal. +351 289 323 299; +351 914 410 132; geral@solgarve.pt; RNET 3498. Avoid copying odd textual coordinates without verification.
content_notes.apartments: All three requested detail pages describe 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, double bed + sofa bed, equipped kitchen, dining/living area, air conditioning, spacious pool-facing balcony. Family: 2 adults + 2 children up to 12; 4pax: 4 people; 2pax: 2 people. No reliable live price; page shows unselected 0.00 total, do not publish as rate.
